question: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh received the 'Lifetime Achievement Award' for his significant contributions in which field?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Diabetes care and research**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Union Minister **Dr. Jitendra Singh** is a renowned medical professional apart from his political contributions. He has made significant advancements in the field of **Diabetes care and research**.
 
• Dr. Singh has been actively involved in the study of **Type 1 and Type 2 Diabetes**, particularly focusing on the prevalence and management of diabetes in the Indian population.
 
• He is also recognized for his work in **diabetes-related complications**, including diabetic neuropathy and retinopathy, which are common in long-term untreated cases.
 
• Dr. Singh has authored numerous **research papers** and has contributed to medical journals, enhancing the body of knowledge in the field of diabetes.
 
• He has also been instrumental in educating the public about the importance of **lifestyle modifications** such as diet, exercise, and early diagnosis to manage diabetes effectively.
 
• As a Union Minister, he has balanced his responsibilities in governance while also promoting **health awareness campaigns**, particularly focusing on the prevention and management of diabetes in rural and urban India.
 
• The **'Lifetime Achievement Award'** recognizes his decades-long contributions and commitment to improving the lives of individuals suffering from diabetes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Cancer research**__

 __
 
• **Cancer research** involves studying the causes, progression, and treatment of various cancers, including lung, breast, colorectal, and prostate cancer.
 
• It focuses on developing **new therapies** such as immunotherapy, targeted drugs, and gene therapy to improve patient outcomes.
 
• Prominent institutions like **AIIMS** and **Tata Memorial Centre** in India are deeply involved in cancer research.
 
 
 
• **Dermatology research**__
 __
 
• **Dermatology research** focuses on studying and treating skin conditions such as eczema, psoriasis, acne, and skin cancers.
 
• Research in this field also includes the development of **cosmetic dermatology** solutions like laser treatments, fillers, and anti-aging therapies.
 
• It plays a critical role in understanding rare diseases like **epidermolysis bullosa** and autoimmune skin disorders.
 
 
 
• **Child care and research**__
 
 
• This field focuses on improving the health and well-being of **children**, including their physical, mental, and emotional development.
 
• It involves studying childhood diseases, nutrition, and the impact of vaccines and preventive healthcare measures.
 
• Organizations like **UNICEF** and **WHO** work extensively in child healthcare and research globally.
